Mokarram Hossain and others ------ Petitioners
Vs.
ADC (Rev) Pabna for Vested and Non-Resident Property (Land and Building) Pabna & others ------ Opposite Parties
full_judgment: 3. Mr. Md Nawab Ali, tried to plead adverse possession on behalf of the plaintiff. Since the defendant opposite party is Government so adverse possession against the Government unless 60 years over, cannot be claimed which is not there in the instant case, plaintiffs possession is however admitted by the defendant. But possession of the plaintiff in the aforesaid circumstance has not created any title by adverse possession. Both the Courts below legally and rightly found on appreciation of the evidence on record that the plaintiff failed to prove his title. Original plaintiff Abul Hossain has died. His minor sons and daughters and wife are residents in the homestead situated on the suit land which is 0.0900 Ajutansha. It is stated by Mr. Noab Ali that the plaintiffs have no other land to live upon.
